name: Memories
tagline: A private, offline vault for the people in your life.
description: Memories keeps a profile for each person you care about, with their photos, videos, favorites, socials and your story together. Everything is encrypted on your phone. There is no account and no cloud.

features.title: Profiles
features.text: Name, birthday, city, contact details, when you met and notes, with tabs for Info, Favorites, Socials and Story.

features.title: Encrypted photos and videos
features.text: Media is stored encrypted and never appears in your Gallery.

features.title: Birthday reminders
features.text: Optional reminders, plus upcoming birthdays above your list.

features.title: Locks itself
features.text: PIN or fingerprint to open, with auto-lock when you leave the app or turn off the screen.

features.title: Encrypted backup
features.text: Export one password-protected file and restore it on a new phone.

features.title: Favorites and socials
features.text: Hobbies, food, movies, music and books, plus links to popular social platforms.

setup: Download the file on your phone and open it.
If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps.
Open Memories and set your PIN and security question.
limits: Keep your backup password safe. Your data stays on the phone, so there is nothing to recover from online.
Android will warn that the app comes from an unknown source.
